description: Normalize two caller-supplied one-dimensional kernels and filter a straight ARGB8 raster horizontally then vertically in premultiplied encoded RGB.

provenance.relationship: Weighted horizontal and vertical source filtering motivates the reusable neighborhood operation; its gain, opaque output, scanlines and vignette are deferred.
Successive anisotropic source shader passes motivate independently controllable axes; fractional texture samples and RGB-mask modulation are deferred.

output_invariants: Owned straight ARGB8 raster with source dimensions and exactly width*height row-major unsigned32 pixels.

behavior.input: Exactly source,kernelX,kernelY,maxSamples. Source dimensions are positive signed32 and their product is at most 2147483647; pixels is exactly that many unsigned32 values. Each kernel is odd, nonempty, length at most 2147483647, finite binary64 nonnegative weights with a positive maximum. maxSamples is a required safe integer [1,9007199254740991]. No defaults.
behavior.preflight: Object form first validates exact top-level and source keys. Typed form first validates dimensions/product and non-null exact pixel count. Validate source dimensions/product/count/values, then kernelX length/values, kernelY length/values, then maxSamples representation. Compute P*(lenX+lenY) with wide integer arithmetic; if it exceeds maxSamples, fail WORK_LIMIT before allocating normalized kernels, output, or intermediates. Zero taps and length-one axes count. All invalid input precedes WORK_LIMIT.
behavior.normalization: For each axis independently, m=max(weights); in index order q[i]=weights[i]/m; S begins positive zero and adds q[i] in index order; normalized[i]=q[i]/S. Binary64 underflow follows the host format. No epsilon, compensation, fast math, or sum-before-scale normalization.
behavior.filtering: If both axes have length one, return detached original packed bits exactly after validation and preflight. Otherwise horizontally visit row-major outputs and X taps in array order at x+i-floor(lenX/2), clamped to source bounds. Start A,R,G,B at zero; a=alpha/255.0; A+=a*w; for each encoded RGB byte c, premult=c*a then component+=premult*w as separate operations. Store four P-length binary64 arrays. Vertically visit row-major outputs and Y taps in order at y+i-floor(lenY/2), clamped; accumulate stored A,R,G,B times normalized Y. No intermediate byte quantization or clamp. Calculate coordinate-plus-offset using wide integer arithmetic before clamping, never overflowing signed32.
behavior.quantization: Q(v)=floor(min(255,max(0,v))+0.5). If final A==0 output packed zero. Else alpha=Q(A*255); if alpha==0 output zero; channels are Q(component/A), packed ARGB. Arithmetic uses ordered IEEE binary64, separately rounded ties-to-even; no FMA, reassociation, or gamma conversion. Nonidentity filtering ignores hidden transparent RGB and canonicalizes final alpha-zero output.
behavior.ownership: Result is immutable, owns detached packed pixels, retains neither source nor kernels, and pixels()/toValues() return detached values. Failed calls expose no partial result. Inputs must remain stable for the call.
behavior.access: width() and height() expose dimensions. pixelAt(Object/long) first requires a finite safe nonnegative integer, then requires index < width*height. Negative zero is zero. Java pixelAt returns an int ARGB bit pattern; portable toValues pixels are unsigned32.
behavior.native_forms: Java contract form: org.procedurals.raster.SeparableBlur2D.blur(Object) and blur(int width,int height,int[] pixels,double[] kernelX,double[] kernelY,long maxSamples). Result: width(), height(), pixelAt(Object or long), pixels(), toValues(). Implementation and native acceptance remain pending.
behavior.carriers: Object records are exact-key Map and arrays List. Numeric input and Object indices accept only Byte, Short, Integer, Long, Float, Double. Reject Boolean, String, BigInteger, BigDecimal, custom Number, null typed buffers, and non-finite/out-of-range forms. Typed kernel values are doubles and typed pixels are int bit patterns.
behavior.limits: Declared work is O(P*(lenX+lenY)); live storage is four P-length double horizontal arrays plus owned P-length output and kernels, O(P+lenX+lenY). No per-pixel objects or full 2D kernel. Allocation failures are host resource failures, never INVALID_INPUT or partial output.
behavior.environment: No RNG, time, noise, renderer, host image, callback, or mutable global state.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Wrong keys, shapes, carriers, dimensions/product, count/value/kernel/maxSamples representation; all configuration validation failures.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: Validated declared work P*(kernelX.length+kernelY.length) exceeds maxSamples.
errors.INVALID_INDEX: pixelAt index is not a finite safe nonnegative integer.
errors.INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: A representable pixelAt index is outside the retained output raster.

error_order: Validate source then kernelX then kernelY then maxSamples; INVALID_INPUT precedes WORK_LIMIT.

source.evidence: Caller retained drawing or image content.

kernelX.evidence: Caller data; no measured artistic kernel range.

kernelY.evidence: Caller data; no measured artistic kernel range.

maxSamples.evidence: Explicit resource bound; all supplied taps count.

comparison: Exact output dimensions, packed pixels and error codes. Independent scalar vectors plus native carrier, ownership, index and typed/object parity checks.
exclusions: Source shader gain, scanlines and vignette
Fractional texture taps and per-channel spatial kernel modulation

reproduction.scope: BlurMarks retained image/filter/mask workflow pending; no complete original recreation claimed.
